_finding: Owner, 25.11 (docs/list-locks-tz.md v3, after two outside reviews): the factory mirror becomes a source a verdict will rest on, so it records only finalized creations, checks every log before it counts, records success apart from an attempt, and is read by one validator that refuses a file from other pins or an older schema. Each recorded creation is checked against the chain again once a day and taken back if the chain no longer holds it; a missing receipt alone never revokes. A creation is revoked only on proof from the block (the recorded block replaced, or holding no such log), never on a missing receipt or transaction, and a valid log read later restores it. The lookup and the reconcile take only a log that passes tokenOf, for the address looked for, inside the block found; the bisection keeps to its budget and paces its calls.
